--result-json.description: For an inline stage with only declared artifact files, submit {"status":"completed"}; the runtime discovers and hashes those files. Keep actual child results and supporting artifacts unchanged; optional hashes must use sha256:<64-hex>. Completion validates final artifacts, records the receipt and settles the stage without candidate-save or --finalize. Approval decisions apply only to pendingApproval. Update stale candidate hashes when artifacts changed.

shellSafeAlternative.description: Write the JSON to a UTF-8 file and pass --result-json-file <path> when the command must go through a shell; inline JSON loses its quotes on Windows PowerShell.
